high_level_description: stc brand style, a cozy home office workspace at night with warm ambient lighting.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark wall with a wooden desk on black metal legs, a built-in wooden shelving unit with books and decor, a warm orb-shaped light source, and light brown hardwood flooring.

elements.desc: A silver adjustable desk lamp positioned on the left side of the desk.
A wooden chair with a curved backrest and dark upholstery tucked under the desk.
A small potted succulent on the desk and a red book visible on the shelving unit.
